objects.name: spawnpoint_block
objects.prompt: A single square player spawn marker for a colorful top-down Bomberman-style game, designed as a reusable game object. A compact square platform viewed directly from above, with a thick dark outer outline, a clean beveled border and a flat solid-colored inner square. Slightly rounded pixel-art corners, subtle dimensional shading and a simple symmetrical design. The central square must have a uniform neutral light azul color, with no colored accents, gradients or patterns. The outer frame should use neutral dark blue and. The design must be easy to recolor by changing only the central square color. Keep the shape, outline, border, shading, proportions and lighting identical across all color variations. No text, no numbers, no characters, no additional objects. 32x32 pixel art game object sprite, cute cartoon style matching a friendly top-down game, single object centered, flat cel shading with only two tones per color, thick dark outline, bright readable palette with clearly separated light and dark parts. No volumetric shading, no gritty mood, no realistic rendering, no texture, no gradient, no anti-aliasing. Light from the upper left. Transparent background. Nothing outside the object itself, no sparkles, no glow

Thick, sturdy brown trunk with visible branching roots spreading slightly across the ground. Wide and imposing silhouette, dense foliage, thick dark outlines, clean 16-bit pixel art shading. Rich but controlled colors, consistent light source from the upper left. Isolated tree, no background, no extra objects, no flowers, no fruit, no ground tile.
